Build your programming skills in a fun way. Learn to code with a game-like learning experience. Explore interactive coding lessons with a one-stop code learning app.

Learn to code with HTML, Javascript, C, C++, C#, Swift, Python, R Programming, Java, Artificial Intelligence, CSS, etc.  for free.

You will learn to code like an expert, and also enjoy it like a game. It's easy, it's fast and it's fun!

With a huge collection of 5000+ programs (code examples), 35+ courses, and the fastest compiler in the world, all your programming needs are bundled in a single app for your daily practice.  

What all programming languages you can learn with this coding tutor app?  

• Learn Java - Java is an object-oriented, general-purpose, high-level programming language.   

• Learn C Programming - C programming is a powerful general-purpose language.

• Learn C++ -  C++ is used nearly everywhere for everything from systems programming, numerical and scientific computing, web development, writing compilers, console games, desktop applications, and so on.

• Learn HTML - HTML is the standard markup language for creating web pages and web applications.  

• Learn Javascript - JavaScript is a web programming language that is run by most browsers.  

• Learn R Programming: R is a programming language and software environment for statistical analysis, graphics representation, and reporting.

With the “Programming Hub: Learn to code” app, you can - 

• Learn CSS 
• Learn VB.net
 • Learn C# (C Sharp) 
• Learn Python 2.7
• Learn Python 3
• Learn Linux Shell Scripting 
• Learn R Programming 
• Learn Swift 
• Learn SQL
 • Learn jQuery
 • Learn Assembly 8086

APP FEATURES
**************************
While we make coding learning easy and fun, here are features that would make us your single choice to learn programming languages -

• Programming Courses: To make your learning more interesting, our experts have created bite-sized and interactive courses that will help you learn programming like never before.

• Programming & Coding Examples: 5000+ programs in 20+ programming languages and counting, programming hub has one of the largest collection of pre-compiled programs with output for practice and learning.  

• Compiler: The fastest compiler in the world on iOS with support to compile and run over 20+ programming languages. 

Other Features to improve your programming learning experience includes - 

1. Concept-based illustrations to easily learn to code

android.desc: Learn to code with Programming Hub, a Google Play Editors' Choice app trusted by 10 million+ learners. Bite-sized coding courses, 5000+ ready-to-run programs, and a compiler that runs your code on your phone. Writing your first line of code or preparing for a technical interview, you can learn programming at your own pace, online or offline. Programming Languages Covered: 👨‍💻 Python - Learn Python 3 from scratch. This Python coding app carries you from your first Python program to data analysis, automation and Python interview questions. Run every Python exercise in the compiler, no laptop required. Python remains the most common starting point for anyone new to programming. 👨‍💻 Java - Java powers Android apps, enterprise backends and big data. Learn Java syntax, object-oriented programming and real projects written in Java, then run Java in the compiler. Java is a strong second language for coding interviews. 👨‍💻 Artificial Intelligence - Understand AI, machine learning and gen AI foundations. This artificial intelligence course explains how AI models are built, trained and prompted, and where gen AI belongs in a modern coding workflow. Prompt engineering and artificial intelligence tooling are covered end to end, so artificial intelligence stops being a black box. 👨‍💻 C - C is the clearest first step into systems programming, and the language most computer science courses begin with. Learn C pointers, memory and structs, and read C code that ships in production. 👨‍💻 C++ - C++ runs game engines, compilers and high-performance software. Learn C++ from basics through STL, and see how C++ builds on C. 👨‍💻 C# - C# is the language behind Unity games and .NET applications. Master C# classes, LINQ and async, and run C# code in the compiler. 👨‍💻 JavaScript - JavaScript is the programming language of every browser. Learn JavaScript with HTML and CSS, then use JavaScript to build for the web. 👨‍💻 SQL - Learn SQL and query databases. Every backend and data role expects SQL, and SQL is the quickest skill here to put to work. Also included: R, Swift, Kotlin and Linux Shell Scripting, in one coding app. APP FEATURES 🚀 Programming courses - interactive, bite-sized lessons created in collaboration with Google experts. Learn programming concepts through illustrations instead of walls of text. 🚀 Compiler - a built-in compiler that runs 20+ programming languages on your phone. Write code, tap run, read your code

quotes.text:
I am new to this community and happy to be here.

I am the maker of an app called Programming Hub that makes it easy for beginners to start learning programming languages. It is also useful to practice programming and brush up skills to become interview ready. I have seen a lot of people looking for kickstarts on learning different programming languages or wanting to prepare for coding interviews. This app is my attempt to solve this problem.

The app has been recognised by Google as -

Google Play's Editor's Choice

Google's "Best of the Best" of 2017

Recently, we have revamped our app and I am looking for feedback.

Android app link - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.freeit.java

iOS app link - https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/programming-hub/id1049691226

Thanks.
